description: This file defines a React functional component named Popover, which manages popover UI elements, including context registration, media query handling for responsiveness, and integration with Android back button handling. It conditionally renders mobile or positioned popover content based on screen size and props.

methods.name: useRegisterPopoverToParent
methods.description: Custom hook that registers and unregisters the popover's ID with the parent context.

methods.name: Popover
methods.description: Main React component that displays a popover, handles responsiveness, context registration, and back button behavior.
